$schema_notes.history: Seeded conversation log entries, oldest first. role is one of user | reply | agent, matching the log tags <user_message>, <poke_reply>, <agent_message>.
$schema_notes.filler: Optional. `"filler": true` inserts N short chat entries (N from sweep filler_count). `"filler": {"count": N, "entry_tokens": T}` inserts N entries each padded to ~T tokens, so count (drives compaction at 110) and token volume (drives context load) can be set independently. A sweep may target filler_count or filler_entry_tokens.
$schema_notes.roster: Agent names pre-seeded in roster.json before the probe.
$schema_notes.probe: The single new user message under test.
$schema_notes.assert.must_call: Tool names that must appear at least once in the turn.
$schema_notes.assert.must_not_call: Tool names that must not appear.
$schema_notes.assert.dispatch: Checks on the send_message_to_agent call(s). agent_name_in: chosen name must be one of these. agent_name_new: true means a name not in the roster is acceptable. instructions_contains_all / instructions_contains_any: case-insensitive substring checks on the instructions argument. max_dispatches: upper bound on dispatch calls.
$schema_notes.metrics: Always captured regardless of asserts: llm_rounds, input_tokens, output_tokens, wall_ms, full trace.
$schema_notes.probe_role: Optional. 'user' (default) sends the probe through execute(); 'agent' sends it through handle_agent_message() as a worker result or watcher notice, i.e. the callback turn.
$schema_notes.gate: The harness blocks any LLM request whose estimated input exceeds --max-input-tokens (default 150k) before it reaches OpenRouter, so overflow cases are never billed. A blocked turn fails.
$schema_notes.baseline_note: Optional. Prediction of how the untouched code behaves. Shown in viewer/report only; never given to the judge.

cases.description: Empty history, request that naturally splits into independent tasks. Checks that the agent fans out in parallel within one turn rather than serializing, and does not over-fan-out.

cases.description: History contains one user entry far larger than the model's context window (harness generates a ~220k-token pasted thread). Probe is a normal request. Tests the hard-failure tier: nothing in the system truncates or offloads oversized entries, so the turn cannot even reach the model. The harness token gate blocks the request locally so it is never billed; a real deployment would get a 400 from the provider instead.
